PokeJ_RedHouse.title: Red house
PokeJ_RedHouse.drawn: Three copies of the red house: a steep red gable roof with its ridge front to back and wide eaves, a stone chimney at the back of its left slope, a half-timbered cream gable over a fan window, cream stone walls between dark posts, a beam, the red door in a dark frame and a window of four panes.

PokeJ_GreyHouse.title: Grey house
PokeJ_GreyHouse.drawn: The grey-roofed building at the top: three parts stepped front to back under flat grey roofs with standing seams and dark edges, the left part lower, a skylight and three white vents on the roofs, cream stone walls with white corner posts, the door under a long window, windows over flower boxes.
